fullPassage: Fritz Zwicky, a memorable astrophysicist who coined the term 'supernova', was born in Varna, Bulgaria to a Swiss father and a Czech mother. At the age of six, he was sent to his grandparents who looked after him for most of his childhood in Switzerland. There, he received an advanced education in mathematics and physics. In 1925, he emigrated to the United States and continued his physics research at California Institute of Technology (Caltech). He developed numerous theories that have had a profound influence on the understanding of our universe in the early 21st century. After being appointed as a professor of astronomy at Caltech in 1942, he developed some of the earliest jet engines and holds more than 50 patents, many in jet propulsion.

det.korean: send → sent: be동사 뒤 수동태 과거분사
det.analysis: 'he was __________ (send) to his grandparents'에서 be동사(was) 뒤 수동태 과거분사가 필요. 그는 '보내진' 대상이므로 send → sent
det.tip: was sent to ~ = ~에게 보내졌다 (수동태)

questions.passage: Fritz Zwicky, a memorable astrophysicist who coined the term 'supernova', was born in Varna, Bulgaria to a Swiss father and a Czech mother. At the age of six, he was sent to his grandparents who looked after him for most of his childhood in Switzerland. There, he received an advanced education in mathematics and physics. In 1925, he emigrated to the United States and continued his physics research at California Institute of Technology (Caltech). He developed numerous theories that have had a profound influence on the understanding of our universe in the early 21st century. After being appointed as a professor of astronomy at Caltech in 1942, he developed some of the earliest jet engines and holds more than 50 patents, many in jet propulsion.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② 여러 분야에서 큰 업적을 남긴 천체물리학자
det.analysis:
❌ ① 특허 수와 위대함: 본문 취지가 아님
✅ ② 여러 분야의 업적: 'supernova' 용어 창안, 우주 이해에 영향을 준 이론, 제트 엔진·특허 등 천체물리학과 공학을 아우르는 업적이 요지 ←정답
❌ ③ 이민자 성공 불가: 그는 이민 후 큰 성공을 거둠
❌ ④ 두 분야 무관: 본문은 그가 두 분야 모두에 기여함을 보여줌
det.tip: 요지 = 천체물리학·공학 등 여러 분야의 큰 업적

ch: 한 천체물리학자는 천체물리학과 공학 등 여러 분야에서 큰 업적을 남겼다.
이민자는 과학 연구에서 성공할 수 없다.
